verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents building automations and event-triggered flows that run on an ongoing basis. Campaigns can be created through the API and MCP server, and Composer can map out a send strategy. None of this shows explicit scheduling of recurring, time-based jobs. Missing for 10: documented recurring or cron-style scheduling of workflows or campaigns, API/MCP control over schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
